title: Scheduled browser shared authoritative admission and one-shot transition

conditions.description: Provide an accepted, production-capable shared typed interface and composition source for scheduled sender: authenticated project/ledger binding and complete occupancy, same-CAS policy revision/role/generation-bound reservation, atomic one-shot send transition before BrowserBridge effect, and trusted terminal/proven-no-send handling; identify exact source and allowed wiring/lease. Alternatively explicitly reconcile the assignment to authorize a standalone default-off deny-all switch and its configuration contract. W21 abef95d is explicitly disposable and production beginSend is test-only; W16 686971c is a fixture, neither is send authority. Scheduled action has no target/role and may run disconnected. See W14 checkpoint 14518.
